summary: Q3 revenue rose 11% YoY to SAR 3.0B, but EBITDA fell 24% to SAR 870M due to elevated sulfur costs and phosphate shipping delays.
Aluminum and gold posted record financial results; aluminum EBITDA doubled YoY while gold EBITDA jumped 71% on 22% higher production.
Phosphate margins compressed from high sulfur prices and logistics disruptions; ammonia exports remain constrained by geopolitical conditions.
Ma'aden cut 2026 capex guidance by $1.0B; maintains net debt/EBITDA at 1.4x with $3.5B cash, below 2.0x-3.0x target range.
Formed 51%-owned exploration JV with Saudi Aramco targeting copper and transition minerals; aluminum premium expected to normalize in 2027.
